The new TNM staging system may provide additional information on the biological characteristics of early gastric cancer, which can help in predicting its behavior and potentially guiding treatment decisions.

However, it's essential to note that the effectiveness of the 7th TNM edition in predicting biological behavior is still being evaluated and may vary depending on individual patient factors. Further research and studies are needed to confirm its prognostic value.
